query: What is Snap's most recently reported number of monthly active users, and its most recently reported number of full-time employees? Give each figure with its reporting period and the primary source.
report: Snap most recently reported 977 million monthly active users (MAUs) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, in its Q3 2026 financial results press release / accompanying materials [1][2]. Snap most recently reported 4,540 full-time employees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (full-time; excluding part-time, contractors, and temporary personnel), in the same Q3 2026 supplemental financial information table [1].
